title_sq: Prane Maternitetit ,Shitet Ambient Biznesi Me Oborr Post Parkimi!!!
description_sq: Prane Maternitetit, Tek Kompleksi' MGB 'Shitet Ambient Biznesi Me Oborr + Post Parkimi . title_en: Near the Maternity Hospital, Business Space for Sale with Yard and Post Parking!!!
description_en: Near the Maternity Hospital, at the "MGB" Complex, a business premises for sale with a yard + parking lot. The store has a total area of ​​101 m2, net area 91.2 m2 and is organized in an open space environment and a toilet. The store is in the front part of the building and has a facade to advertise your business. This option is perfect for businesses of different types such as bars, restaurants, beauty salons, dental clinics, biochemical laboratories, exchanges, private gardens, supermarkets, travel agencies, etc. Currently, this part of the residence is occupied and you can use it personally or you can rent it, since the demand in the area is high. The building has contemporary works where thermal insulation of the facade can be noticed, windows equipped with double thermal glass, acoustic insulation, hydraulic systems of quality brands, installations for central heating - cooling multisplit air conditioning system, elevators of one of the most popular brands in the market.
